digest.component_or_area: Git store synchronization and snapshot fetches
propositions: Parallel Git fetches against a shared common directory race to update remote-tracking refs, causing stale-reference compare-and-swap failures with 'cannot lock ref' and 'is at <new> but expected <old>'
The sync fetch in reconverge and snapshot fetch paths lack cross-process coordination despite both updating the same refs in the shared Git common directory

Existing per-operation locks (git-op lock, snapshot lock) do not cover fetch legs and are keyed on per-worktree Git directories, failing to serialize concurrent ref updates to shared common-directory refs
Parallel execution produces the stale-reference failure consistently while serialized execution eliminates it, confirming the fetch race is the root cause
The fix requires a blocking common-directory identity lock for all fetch entry points plus bounded retry of CAS mismatches, while preserving network I/O outside the ticket write lock
Production occurrences show plan reviews, comments, and snapshot verifications failing closed or silently discarding updates during concurrent sessions using the same tracker
